resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts marks the Sugarloaf entry Removed, which implies a lookout once stood there. The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the same point among unknown and undocumented sites, meaning it does not confirm use as a fire lookout. Both are reported; neither is settled.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No source read gives a built date, design, staffing, or history; the FFLA gives the point no type or status. Whether a lookout ever stood here is undocumented, so the brief gone status is not confirmed by the FFLA and is marked unverified rather than corrected. The Boulder Public Library Sugarloaf Mountain photo collection (localhistory.boulderlibrary.org) returned 403 and was not read; it may show the site. The story is about 150 words.
